clauses.claim: At least one import pass of the agent host's own tool-call log is recorded in the holder's book.
clauses.label: The host's tool-call log was imported into the book

clauses.claim: No import pass the holder answered with declared a gap: no stretch of the host's log was unreadable, expired before a pass read it, or a cursor range the host never used.
clauses.label: No gap declared in the imported log

clauses.claim: No import pass the holder answered with listed a row that arrived late, a re-read row whose content changed after it was first digested, or an id that appears twice in one pass with different contents.
clauses.label: No late or changed rows in the imported log

outcome_statement: The holder's book shows the agent host's tool-call log was imported with no declared gap and no late or changed row. The book records what the host wrote down when each pass read it; it does not show what the agent did that the host did not write, or that the host's own log is true.
title: Goose agent record-keeping
